lines.en: Throughout my reading of 『Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World』, there was one thing I imagined more than anything else.
―What if ‘Ways of Survival’ became reality?
Anyone with a favorite novel has probably imagined something like that at least once.
So had I. Perhaps I had adapted so well to ‘Ways of Survival’ thanks to the endless possibilities I had imagined as a child.
When the scenarios started, I would do this first, then that, look for this hidden piece······.
In middle school, I had even drawn up charts in the corners of my textbooks.

―Yoo Joonghyuk: Former professional gamer, incredibly bad personality, psychopath, kills you if talking gets nowhere (sometimes just kills you anyway), absolutely must get him on my side, still has some humanity left up through the third round······.
When I first realized I had landed in the ‘third round’ of Ways of Survival, I thought I was lucky.
I thought I was truly lucky to have come to a ‘world I could still change’.
If I had landed in the final round······.
「Kim Dok ja thou ght」
There would be no one who could stop him.
「Fuu―ck」
Whoooooosh!
Watching the blade whistle through the air toward me, I shouted with all my strength.
[Wait! Stop! I said stop!]
Over a thousand regressions.
Hundreds of suicides, and a mind numbed by tragedy beyond the limit any one person could endure. Regression Depression that had become all-consuming······.
「The Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round is this world's despair itself.」
At the critical instant when the unhesitating blade was about to slice through my neck, I thought fast.
[Activating the exclusive skill, ‘Miniaturization Lv.10’!]
My body shrank in an instant, and the unfeeling blade swept through empty air.
Beyond the blade, I saw his startled eyes.
You bastard. Did you think I came all this way to die?
He might be in his 1863rd round, but if he thought I would go down without a fight, he was mistaken.
[Activating the exclusive skill, ‘Bookmark’!]
[The exclusive skill, ‘Electrification Lv.12(+2)’, has been activated!]
I knew I was no match for him.
Still, I had to at least put up a desperate fight.
I darted away like lightning and shouted at him.
“You son of a bitch! How am I supposed to answer if you won't let me talk!”
As I shouted, indirect messages poured out of thin air.
[Some constellations have noticed your presence.]
[The constellation, ‘Adventurer Who Stands Up an Egg’, is intrigued by your appearance.]
[The constellation, ‘King of Mayflies’, takes an interest in your resistance against the ‘Iron Blood Supreme King’.]
[Several constellations feel intensely jealous of you.]
[You have received 1000 coins in sponsorship.]
Scenario 95 of the 1863rd round.
Even with the world in this state, there were still constellations offering sponsorship.
Though the nature of their sponsorship was a little different from what I was used to······.
Yoo Joonghyuk glared at me, his expression stiff.
“The White Purity Sect's martial arts? Strange. Those should have been lost in this round······.”

I could feel the gears of his mind, twisted by over a thousand regressions, spinning furiously. Based solely on what I had done so far, he would already have decided whether to kill me or let me live. I was afraid.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’!]
But precisely because I was afraid, I had to read now.
That was the only way to get out of this.
[Your understanding of this individual is insufficient to activate ‘Stage 2’ of Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint!]
[Activating ‘Stage 1’ of Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint!]
······Insufficient understanding.
It hurt my pride a little, but I could see how that might be true.
After all, this wasn't just any Yoo Joonghyuk. This was the Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round.
I had no choice but to make do with Stage 1. Even if I couldn't read his thoughts in detail, knowing which direction his attacks would come from would help······.
「Neck」
The instant Yoo Joonghyuk's thought reached me, I retreated with all my strength.
Even he wouldn't be able to catch me easily now. Because on top of [Electrification], I was now using [Way of the Wind]······.
I couldn't tell whether I had turned first or a pitch-black shadow had overtaken me first. My breath caught, my knees went numb, and my vision began to blacken.
Crrrrrunch.
A frenzy of magic power constricted me as if to crush my entire body. I flailed in midair like an electrocuted fish. An immense amount of magic power shook me from head to toe.
[Several constellations mock your appearance.]

When the darkness cleared from my vision, Yoo Joonghyuk's face was right before me. His hand gripped my torso hard enough to crush it. My neck, caught between his thumb and forefinger, hurt as though it would snap.
I couldn't believe it.
Even if he was the Yoo Joonghyuk of the final round, had he really caught me this easily with my [Electrification] active?
“I'll ask one last time.”
The moment I heard his cold voice, I understood.
I had been an idiot to think knowing the direction in advance meant I could dodge.
The man before me now was not the inexperienced Yoo Joonghyuk of the third round.
“Where is the dragon-slaying sword, ‘Arondight’?”
······I wanted to scream at him to please stop asking questions while gripping my throat.
“Since Lancelot's incarnation body is here, you must know······.”
Oh, that constellation who had just died was ‘Lancelot’? Damn it.
“If you won't answer, I'll have to find out by force.”
Yoo Joonghyuk's eyes shone gold.
As expected, whether it was the third round or the 1863rd, Yoo Joonghyuk never changed at his core.
[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ has activated ‘Sage's Eye Lv.???’!]

Over thousands of regressions, his ‘Sage's Eye’ had reached a terrifying level. By now, the only beings those eyes probably couldn't see through were Outer Gods who had lived longer than Yoo Joonghyuk.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Fourth Wall’, has detected ‘Sage's Eye’!]
[The exclusive skill, ‘Fourth Wall’, activates strongly!]
The moment Yoo Joonghyuk's ‘Sage's Eye’ swept over my body, the wall moved.
Before a gaze that bore down relentlessly on me, as though determined not to miss a single scrap of information, the [Fourth Wall] stood firm, as though refusing to leave even the slightest opening.
Bzzzzzzzt!
Sparks more powerful than those from its encounter with the ‘Unidentifiable Wall’ erupted before my eyes.
「Not bad」
It seemed even the [Fourth Wall] was having a hard time on this occasion. At this point, I couldn't tell whether it was the [Fourth Wall] that was incredible, or Yoo Joonghyuk.
The [Fourth Wall] wouldn't back down, and Yoo Joonghyuk wouldn't give up. Which left me being fried to death between them.
Just as the unbearable pain had me wondering whether I should at least scream with my True Voice.
Yoo Joonghyuk withdrew his power first. Their clash must have been fierce; his eyes, swirling with golden light, were bloodshot.
[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ feels a desire to win.]
[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ displays intense hostility toward you!]
A barrier even that ‘Sage's Eye’ couldn't penetrate.
Once again, I realized what an incredible skill the [Fourth Wall] was.
That was when something strange happened.
Bzzzzzzzt!

Not content with blocking Yoo Joonghyuk's ‘Sage's Eye’, the [Fourth Wall] began flowing like water over the back of the hand gripping me. As the letters pouring out covered his body like a swarm of insects, Yoo Joonghyuk sounded flustered for the first time.
The writhing letters soon formed a memory and streamed past like a panorama. It was a memory of my ‘third round’, recorded on the [Fourth Wall].
「“Let go of me and fuck off, you bastard.”」
「“Probably. Anyway, there's definitely reason for hope.”
“······What is there to be hopeful about?”
“Joonghyuk, we can save the world. You know that, right?”」
「“Our nebula's name is······ Kim Dokja’s Company······.”
“There is no name yet. And we will find supporters starting now.”」
Memories the Yoo Joonghyuk before me could not understand.
None of these things had happened in this round.
Bzzzzzz······.
The blinding sparks gradually subsided, slowly revealing Yoo Joonghyuk's expression.
“Who the hell are you······?”
That ‘1863rd-round’ man had a look of utter shock in his eyes.
As though it found the situation amusing, the [Fourth Wall]'s voice sounded in my head.
「I did well didn't I Kim Dok ja」
Did well?
“Speak. What was that just now? If you don't tell me, I'll tear you to pieces.”
Crrrrrack!
What the fuck do you mean, did well?
[Ghk······ No, wait! Just give me a little time to answer······!]
Crrrrrunch!
I unleashed a burst of blue-white magic power inside Yoo Joonghyuk's grip.
It was a desperate struggle to escape his hand somehow. This probably wouldn't be enough, but I had to at least buy time until I could borrow the power of my ‘Giant Story’······.
KABOOOOM!

But something unexpected happened. Yoo Joonghyuk lost his grip on me in the explosion. He looked bewildered, as though he too was surprised. He sluggishly reached out again. I wondered what had happened, but I couldn't waste this hard-won chance.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Way of the Wind Lv.11(+1)’, has been activated!]

As I activated [Way of the Wind] at full power, blue-white currents left a rainbow-like trail across the sky. I thought he would pursue me immediately, but unexpectedly, I didn't sense Yoo Joonghyuk right away. I turned to see what was going on and found an unexpected sight.
······What's that?
As I wondered, an ear-piercing True Voice rang through the sky.
[Yoo Joonghyuk! I will avenge ‘Immeasurable Austerity’!]
Red and blue eyes blazing on the roof of a nearby building. Two black panthers with sleek, streamlined bodies were plunging toward Yoo Joonghyuk, radiating immense Status.
[The demon king, ‘Devil of Comfort and Savagery’, displays hostility toward the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’!]
[The demon king, ‘Eyes that See the Forbidden’, bares its teeth at the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’!]
The Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round was stronger than in any other round, but he had that many more enemies.
That made it easy for me to recall the two panthers' true names.
The Devil of Comfort and Savagery, ‘Ose’.
Eyes that See the Forbidden, ‘Flauros’.
They were the demon kings of the 57th and 64th Demon Realms, respectively.
Those proud demon kings had forgotten their shame and were launching a combined assault on a single incarnation.
But it was nothing to be ashamed of.
[‘Demon King Slayer’! Today, your story ends here!]
The present Yoo Joonghyuk was more than worthy of such treatment.
Rrrrrumble!

Thinking this was a stroke of luck, I hid amid the erupting roar. Then I cautiously observed the situation. The thought that I should get farther away while I had the chance warred with the desire to watch a little more of that fight.
This was no ordinary battle, but a fight involving Yoo Joonghyuk in his 1863rd round.
It wasn't a sight you got to see every day.
KABOOOOOOM!
A deafening explosion rang out, and the battle began.
[Many constellations are thrilled by ‘incarnation Yoo Joonghyuk’ in battle!]
Amid the flood of indirect messages, Yoo Joonghyuk drew his sword.
The [Splitting the Sky Sword], which had already broken in the third round.
Refined to an entirely new level through countless scenarios, its blade shone brilliantly in the darkness.
As if to oppose it, the demon kings unleashed their own powers.
[Creatures, rise from death!]
Dead earls and dukes of the Demon Realm burst out of the ground as undead. Each one an elite who retained the fighting strength they had possessed in life.
But Yoo Joonghyuk showed no sign of alarm.
“‘Summon the Dead’? The ‘Demon God of Necromancy’ used that too.”
Yoo Joonghyuk was smiling.
“That bastard's corpse now hangs among the stars of the dead constellations.”
[Shut up!]
The moment a ray of light flashed, Yoo Joonghyuk's sword moved.
What should I call that swordsmanship?
······Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship?
I didn't know.
What I did know was that it was swordsmanship of chilling beauty.
Kyaaaaaah!
And swordsmanship of astonishing cruelty.
Graaaaaaagh!
The Demon Realm nobles cut down by his sword screamed as they disintegrated.
A high-ranking duke of the Demon Realm was comparable to a Historical-grade constellation.
Yet several such beings were bursting apart with every swing.
After killing dozens of undead nobles in an instant (瞬殺), all in less than a single minute, Yoo Joonghyuk was already right in front of Demon King Flauros.
CRRRUNCH!
Demon King Flauros's head exploded as though it were a toy.
With eyes devoid of emotion. With a numb smile, in a single blow.
Yoo Joonghyuk killed a demon king.
[You······ You mad bastard!]
The enraged Demon King Ose unleashed Status and shouted.
[Constellations! What are you waiting for!]
At that call, constellations sprang out from hiding throughout the ruins.
Most were constellations aligned with ‘Absolute Evil’.
From Historical-grade to Narrative-grade. These distinguished constellations, each formidable in their own right, were rushing at a single Yoo Joonghyuk in a pack, intent on killing him.
[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ is telling the Story ‘Hell of Eternity’!]
Yet Yoo Joonghyuk didn't give an inch.
The blood-red aura billowing from his entire body clashed with the constellations.
Crunch! Crrrunch!
His power was terrifyingly overbearing, yet every blow carried composure and restraint.
Every time Yoo Joonghyuk's sword moved, the constellations' ranks wavered helplessly.
[Constellations aligned with Absolute Evil hate the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
The constellations' incarnation bodies, bursting apart one by one.
How could those lofty constellations look so pathetic?
Without a trace of impatience on his face, Yoo Joonghyuk continued fighting.
[The character ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ is telling the Giant Story ‘Lonely Pilgrim of Destruction’!]
Yoo Joonghyuk was even defeating the constellations using only his ‘left arm’.
Every time a constellation fell, goosebumps rose on my arms.
[Some constellations aligned with Absolute Evil are shocked by how the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ fights.]
Hatred turned to shock.
[Some constellations aligned with Absolute Evil fear the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
And shock soon turned to fear.
[Many constellations shudder at the power of the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
A shiver ran through me.
A mad bastard······ He really was a mad bastard.
No matter how hard I thought, I couldn't come up with any way to defeat the present Yoo Joonghyuk
I didn't know what scenario I would receive from ‘Secretive Plotter’, but until it was over, I absolutely could not become that man's enemy.
Then a message sounded.
[A sub-scenario commissioned by ‘Secretive Plotter’-nim has arrived!]
At last, the message I had been waiting for arrived.
The personal scenario of ‘Secretive Plotter’.
<Sub-Scenario (Secretive Plotter) ― ??? >
Category: Sub (Personal)
Difficulty: ???
Clear Conditions: ???
Time Limit: ―
Reward: You may return to your original round with one Story (1), one skill (1), and one item (1) acquired in this round (the probability required will be borne by the proposer of this scenario).
Failure: Unable to return to your original round; incarnation body destroyed
The instant I opened the scenario window, the ‘Reward’ field caught my attention.
[The Bureau is currently questioning your probability.]
I didn't originally belong to this ‘round’.
So even if I acquired items, skills, or Stories here, I wouldn't be able to retain them upon returning to my original round.
Just as ‘Disaster Shin Yoosung’, who had crossed over from the 41st round, had been so severely weakened that she couldn't properly wield her ‘Status’.
But if this ‘reward’ was real······ I could take what I gained in this scenario back to my original round.

It was a reward staggering enough to make my head spin. Whatever restrictions probability imposed, the spoils of Scenario 95 were things suited to the difficulty of Scenario 95. Even skills and Stories that were mediocre here would wield enough power to transform heaven and earth in Scenario 20.
「Don't get car ried away Kim Dok ja」
At the [Fourth Wall]'s rebuke, I barely managed to calm myself.
In truth, this wasn't a situation I could simply celebrate.
As tremendous as this scenario's reward was, the price of failure was just as great.
If I failed, I would not only be unable to return to my original round, but would also lose my incarnation body.

Since this wasn't the round I belonged to, my ‘Stories’ had little influence here. If I lost my incarnation body under those circumstances, I might be annihilated forever in the backlash of probability.
Besides, that wasn't actually the biggest problem.
[The clear conditions for this scenario are being updated.]
The most important part, the clear conditions, still hadn't been updated.
I couldn't tell whether an error had occurred while I crossed dimensions or ‘Secretive Plotter’ was deliberately stalling.
Honestly, either was possible.
Watching Yoo Joonghyuk in the distant melee, I thought.
If I were ‘Secretive Plotter’, what would I have set as this scenario's ‘clear conditions’?
Judging by the actions of ‘Secretive Plotter’ so far······.
Only ominous possibilities came to mind.
[The exclusive skill, ‘Reading Comprehension’, is activating!]
Secretive Plotter.
An Outer God whose identity I couldn't be certain of, though I suspected ‘Crawling Chaos’.

We had been together since the channel first opened, but I knew almost nothing about this being. Neither as magnanimous as the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, nor as righteous as Uriel, nor as evil as the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’······ A constellation who hadn't even existed in the original ‘Ways of Survival’.
Exactly as the modifier said, this was simply a ‘Secretive Plotter’.
[You cannot read the target with the information you possess.]
[Activation of the exclusive skill, ‘Reading Comprehension’, is canceled.]
[Curiosity about the unknown (未知) awakens a new ability within you.]
······I didn't know.
What exactly had the Plotter intended to show me through this scenario?
And what had the Plotter hoped to gain?
An Outer God had never done anything like this before, so it was hardly easy to guess. The one thing I did know.
[Kraaaaaaagh!]
Was that this scenario was very likely connected to the monster massacring constellations over there.
[We've got him! Now! Everyone, attack together!]
[Die, Yoo Joonghyuk!]

While the scenario window briefly distracted me, the battle had taken an unexpected turn. Something was wrong with Yoo Joonghyuk. Only moments ago, he had clearly been dominating the battlefield, slaughtering constellations······.
Sluggish movements.
Yoo Joonghyuk's body was stiffening as he took the full brunt of the bombardment.
······What's wrong with him? What happened?
I adjusted the settings of ‘Character List’ to examine his condition.
●The target is currently afflicted with a status ailment.
A status ailment?
That was impossible.
Who was the Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round?

This ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ was the very man who had crippled the ‘Ruler of Eastern Hell’, ranked second in the Demon Realm, and torn the fourth-ranked ‘Demon God of Necromancy’ to death. None of those present could possibly inflict a ‘status ailment’ on Yoo Joonghyuk as he was now.
Yoo Joonghyuk's empty eyes.
I felt an uneasy sensation, as though something had lodged in my throat.
No, there was someone.
There was exactly one being who could inflict a ‘status ailment’ on him.
●The target is currently suffering from ‘Regression Depression’ of unknown cause.
Yoo Joonghyuk himself.
<Regression Depression>.

His mind, broken by a full 1863 rounds of life, had all but transformed that mental illness into a ‘passive skill’. Once he sank into that depression, the monstrous weight of his memories held his consciousness down, preventing it from resurfacing.
[Kill him! He's not invincible!]
Under the merciless attacks, even Yoo Joonghyuk's sturdy body was beginning to bleed.
It was strange.
Normally, there was no way his ‘Regression Depression’ would flare up in this situation. The Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round had learned how to control the condition.
So why was he like that now······.
「The Fourth Wall says, ‘Ha ha ha’.」
“······Don't tell me this was your doing?”
The [Fourth Wall] didn't answer, but for now, that was the only explanation I could think of. His earlier clash with the [Fourth Wall] must have stirred up some turmoil inside Yoo Joonghyuk.
Damn it, what should I do?
CRRRRACK!
Blood burst from Yoo Joonghyuk's skin as he crouched with his hands over his face.
Thanks to his fully mastered [Diamond Body], his injuries were still minor, but if the battle continued like this, Yoo Joonghyuk's death really was only a matter of time.
「I have to help him.」
「Why should I help that bastard?」
The choices fought inside my mind.
「This Yoo Joonghyuk is a monster. Even if I help him, he'll kill me when he comes to.」
「Think carefully. You don't know the scenario's clear conditions.」
The scenario's clear conditions, still a string of question marks.
「If this scenario's clear condition is ‘Yoo Joonghyuk's death’, then I've been handed a perfect opportunity.」
But.
「If clearing this scenario requires ‘Yoo Joonghyuk's survival’······.」
If Yoo Joonghyuk died here, I would lose everything.
“Damn it······.”
To help him or not.
Yoo Joonghyuk, who had stood so firm, was slowly sinking to his knees.
Bastards who normally wouldn't last a single punch were gleefully tearing at his entire body.
[Hahaha! The Stories of the ‘Iron Blood Supreme King’ will be mine!]
Even if Yoo Joonghyuk died here, he would regress anyway.
Then he would start another new round.
Regress······.
【Then what do you intend to do about the ‘other worlds’?】
······That damned Plotter.
【What becomes of all those worlds you could not save?】
If Yoo Joonghyuk died here, a world that hadn't existed in the original novel would be born.
Yoo Joonghyuk would repeat that hell yet again.
More of the ‘abandoned rounds’ that ‘Secretive Plotter’ had shown me would be created, and the Yoo Joonghyuks in them would once again be caught in the endless wheel of despair······.
······Ah, fuck it.
I activated [Electrification] and flew toward Yoo Joonghyuk, letting demonic energy waft freely from my entire body.
[Hey! Save some for me!]
At my rough True Voice, the demon king and constellations attacking Yoo Joonghyuk looked up at me.
[Who are you?]
[······Demonic energy (魔氣)? I've never seen this one before.]
[Have you come to kill the Demon King Slayer too?]
I saw the enemies' briefly tense expressions relax at the pitch-black demonic energy flowing from my body. Just as expected. I unleashed my ‘Status’ and spoke.
[That's right. Good things should be shared, shouldn't they?]
[Ahem, you're late, so you can't have any of the good Stories.]
[Don't worry. I'll behave and just help from behind.]
[A fine attitude. Now then, everyone, carry on······!]
CRACK!
As the constellation turned away, I smashed the bastard in the head as hard as I could. The bastard let out a bizarre scream, flew in a straight line, and crashed into the ruins.
[Ghh, ugh, ugh······ What are you doing!]
I'd struck to kill, but apparently it hadn't been enough.
Enraged by my sudden attack, the constellations glared at me.
[Are you siding with the ‘Demon King Slayer’?]
Without answering, I unleashed the power of my ‘Giant Story’.
[The Giant Story, ‘Demon Realm's Spring’, begins its story!]
The Story surged from deep within my heart, its pulse throbbing. Sparks enveloped my entire body as the Story's energy began rushing through my veins.
Several constellations recognized my ‘Giant Story’ and cried out in surprise.
[A demon king's Status? I've never heard of one like him.]
Of course you haven't.
I'm not a demon king from your world.
I concentrated the power of [Electrification] once more and blasted the belly of a constellation who had let their guard down.
KABOOOOOM!
The constellation struck by my blow groaned and staggered back a little over ten paces.
It was nothing compared to that Yoo Joonghyuk, but the effect wasn't bad.
Just as I began to think I might be able to hold my own like this.
Bzzzzzt!
[An error has occurred in Story operation.]
[The origin of your ‘Giant Story’ cannot be found in this <Star Stream>.]
[The power of the ‘Giant Story’ is rapidly diminishing.]
······Damn it. So it was going to be like this after all.
The <73rd Demon Realm>, the foundation of my ‘Giant Story’, wasn't here.
Neither were the beings who had created that Giant Story with me.
It was only natural that my Story couldn't wield its proper power.
I called to Yoo Joonghyuk while wildly slashing at the approaching constellations.
“Hey! Snap out of it, you bastard!”
Yoo Joonghyuk didn't answer.
I tried to think of lines that would wake him up, but nothing immediately came to mind.
As my Status began to plummet, Demon King Ose regained his swagger and shouted.
[He's with the Demon King Slayer! Kill him first!]
There were seven constellations, including Demon King Ose.
Naturally, my current strength was nowhere near enough to take them on.
Thwack! Thwaaack!
I desperately dodged their attacks, but Scenario 95 was still Scenario 95. Even though they were merely ordinary constellations aligned with ‘Absolute Evil’, every blow hurt like hell.
Slash!
The relentless assault tore away my flesh, leaving me less and less room to move.
Even in that desperate situation, I kept thinking of ways to wake Yoo Joonghyuk. Ideas came to me, and a few of them would definitely bring him back to his senses.
The problem was what came next.
If I woke him using the methods I had in mind, I would probably die too.
After biting my lip almost hard enough to split it, I slowly opened my mouth.
There was no other choice.
I had expected it might come to this anyway.
I took a short, deep breath, then spoke sharply.
“How long are you going to keep quiet and do nothing?”
The constellations' expressions turned strange at my words.
Their eyes asked what I was suddenly talking about.
I kept talking regardless.
“It would be a problem for you too if I died here.”
Then, the next moment, the pocket over my chest shone brightly, and a True Voice rang out.
[What, you knew?]
Naturally, I wasn't going to wake Yoo Joonghyuk.
I'd have to be crazy to do that when it might get me killed.
“It would be strange if I didn't. Flower arranging isn't a hobby of mine.”
Two flowers tucked into the outer pocket of my coat.
A red cosmos and a white lily.
I hadn't noticed their presence from the start.
To be precise, I had only realized when I crossed the ‘worldline’.
They really were bold constellations.
[Tch. Can't be helped.]
Perhaps they had recognized the owner of that True Voice; the hostile constellations' faces began to darken rapidly. As if mocking them, the ‘lily’ spoke.
[Do we both have to get involved? Jophiel, want to handle it yourself?]
[They are enemies of <Eden>. Immediate execution.]
[······You mean together, right? What a pain. Fine.]
The next moment, a single petal fell from each flower, the cosmos and the lily, and fluttered in the wind.
As the petals drifted away toward the sky, a message appeared before my eyes.
I studied it for a moment, then slowly nodded.
Bzzzzzzzt!
An immense presence began to descend behind me. Watching the constellations' faces fill with horror, I couldn't help grinning.
I had been curious.
About how ‘Jung Heewon’ had felt back then.
And now I understood perfectly.
Six wings extending from my back.
Amid the overflowing probability, the ‘Status’ of <Eden>'s greatest archangels radiated from my entire body.
[The constellation, ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’, has manifested in ‘Seoul’!]
[The constellation, ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’, has manifested in ‘Seoul’!]
[Archangels!]
Demon King Ose stared at me, looking beyond shocked and on the verge of fainting. The constellations aligned with ‘Absolute Evil’ were no different.
For them, <Eden>'s archangels were the worst possible opponents.
With no fewer than two archangels manifesting at once, it would hardly have been surprising if they had fallen over in shock.
[Why are there archangels here? Most of <Eden>'s angels should have died after ‘that incident’······!]
The instant I heard that mutter, I realized my oversight.
This was the world of the 1863rd round.
Gabriel and Jophiel wouldn't yet know what had happened in this round.
[■uck, what kind of bullshit is that?]
Gabriel's True Voice rang out as if she had been waiting. Such colorful swearing befitted Uriel's friend. I tried to stop her before things needlessly escalated.
“Gabriel. There's no need to listen to their nonsense. Let's finish them off quickly!”
[······Don't rush me, you insolent human.]
There was one part of that I could have objected to, but for now I decided to do as she said.
Gabriel's power was descending into my entire body.
[I am the archangel Gabriel.]
Rrrrrumble!
I felt a swelling of Status that made my hair stand on end.
At last, I was going to hear Gabriel's principal Story.
[I have been sent to speak to you and bring you this good news.]
Of course, it was only ‘good news’ if Gabriel was on your side.
[Do not be afraid! Archangels or not, they are merely remnants who have lost their stronghold!]
